SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND ( LOWER(u.user_nm) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(u.email_addr) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.department_nm, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y'
AND NOT (COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y')

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, la.login_id AS loginId, #{tenantCode} AS tenantCode, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '') AS departmentNm, COALESCE( ( SELECT r1.role_code FROM tb_login_account_role lar1 JOIN tb_role r1 ON r1.role_id = lar1.role_id WHERE lar1.login_id = la.login_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN r1.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r1.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 WHEN r1.role_code = 'TENANT_USER' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END, r1.role_id LIMIT 1 ), '' ) AS roleCode, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, la.login_code AS loginCode, la.profile_image AS profileImage, la.stamp_image AS signatureImage, la.stamp_image AS stampImage, COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') AS useAt, COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') AS loginUseAt FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, la.login_id AS loginId, #{tenantCode} AS tenantCode, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '') AS departmentNm, COALESCE( ( SELECT r1.role_code FROM tb_login_account_role lar1 JOIN tb_role r1 ON r1.role_id = lar1.role_id WHERE lar1.login_id = la.login_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN r1.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r1.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 WHEN r1.role_code = 'TENANT_USER' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END, r1.role_id LIMIT 1 ), '' ) AS roleCode, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, la.login_code AS loginCode, la.profile_image AS profileImage, la.stamp_image AS signatureImage, la.stamp_image AS stampImage, COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') AS useAt, COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') AS loginUseAt FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND la.login_code = #{loginCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT la.login_id AS "loginId", la.password_hash AS "passwordHash", COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') AS "useAt" FROM tb_login_account la WHERE la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND la.login_code = #{loginCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_department (tenant_id, department_nm, use_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{departmentNm}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO tb_login_account_role (login_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (login_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO tb_login_account (tenant_id, login_code, password_hash, use_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{loginCode}, #{passwordHash}, #{useAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO tb_user (tenant_id, login_id, user_nm, email_addr, department_id, use_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{loginId}, #{userNm}, #{emailAddr}, #{departmentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{useAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET user_nm = #{userNm}, email_addr = #{emailAddr}, department_id = #{departmentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}

choose.when: UPDATE tb_login_account SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE login_id = #{loginId}

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_login_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
UPDATE tb_login_account SET profile_image = COALESCE(#{profileImage}, profile_image), stamp_image = COALESCE(#{stampImage}, stamp_image), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
